graph = defaultdict(list)

    graph[u].append(v)

cycle_count = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    visited = set()
    stack = deque([i])
    while stack:
        node = stack.pop()
        if node in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(node)
        stack.extend(neighbor for neighbor in graph[node] if neighbor not in visited)
    if len(visited) > 1:
        cycle_count += 1
